tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER THE TENDER DOCUMENTS

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: ICAI/ICMAI Certificate of Practice / Firm Registration Certificate.
Partnership Deed / LLP Agreement / Certificate of Incorporation.
Firm profile includes organizational structure and details of partners.
Office address proof in Karnataka (preferably Bengaluru).
Income Tax Returns / Assessment Orders for last 3 financial years.
Audited Financial Statements for last 3 financial years.
Turnover Certificate for last 3 financial years certified by a Chartered Accountant.
Details of the firm's partners (qualification, membership number, and experience) and manpower strength comprising qualified, semi-qualified, and support staff.

Details of experience in conducting Internal/Statutory Audits of Government Bodies/PSUs, along with relevant experience certificates and details of similar assignments executed during the last two years.
Affidavit regarding non-conviction and absence of criminal proceedings and non-blacklisting/non-debarment by ICAI/ICMAI/Government/PSUs (Attach Annexure IV).
Work Plan and Audit Coverage Schedule.
Signed and stamped copy of complete Tender Document as token of acceptance of terms and conditions.
